description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Tables without a primary key, each with the round-1 rows: XC1 (index on G, then index on N), XC2 (only an index on G), XC3 (unique index on N, then a primary key on ID by CREATE INDEX ... WITH PRIMARY), XD1 (only an index on N DESC), XD2 (index on N DESC, then on N ascending), XD3 (index on N ascending, then on N DESC). For each: dynasets of SELECT ID, s FROM t and ... WHERE N >= 3. Asks which index an unrestricted dynaset follows (creation order, selectivity, primary) and whether a descending index gives descending order. Rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2), s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order; indexes made before the rows.
